about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Don Bacon

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SUPPORTING EARLY-CHILDHOOD EDUCATORS' DEDUCTIONS ACT
statements.title: SUPPORTING EARLY-CHILDHOOD EDUCATORS' DEDUCTIONS ACT
sentences: This is a chance for the United States House to stand on the right side, to support Ukraine in this invasion by Russia, and to make it clear that we oppose the Russian invasion and that we oppose the Russian dictator.
We are going to put tough tariffs, using our Article I authorities, to say we want tariffs on Russia, the invader.
We should be wanting to tariff Russia and those who are buying Russian fuel, propping up their economy.
Our NATO allies are asking us to pass this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2027
statements.title: NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2027
sentences: Artificial intelligence, cyber, quantum, biotechnology, and other emerging capabilities are changing the way wars are fought and won.

Finally, this Defense bill importantly restores our defense spending to 4.5 percent of the GDP, which is critical to deter conflict and reinforce America's commitment to ensuring security and stability around the world.
Mr. Chair, I rise today in strong support of H.R. 8800, the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2027.
This NDAA is a strong, bipartisan bill that takes care of our servicemembers and promotes U.S. military dominance, and I urge all my colleagues to support H.R. 8800.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: UKRAINE SUPPORT ACT
statements.title: UKRAINE SUPPORT ACT
sentences: Ukraine is a democracy, a free market, and rule of law.
Russia is bombing Ukrainian cities every night with ballistic missiles and hypersonic missiles.
He would be standing up for Ukraine and opposing Russia.
By God, I am going to choose Churchill, and this House better choose Churchill tonight.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HAPPY 90TH BIRTHDAY TO BETH RAGLAND
statements.title: HAPPY 90TH BIRTHDAY TO BETH RAGLAND
sentences: Council has held leadership roles in many organizations such as the Urban League of Nebraska, North Omaha Community Care Council, and United Way of the Midlands.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: WELCOMING THE ECUMENICAL PATRIARCH OF CONSTANTINOPLE, HIS ALL HOLINESS BARTHOLOMEW
statements.title: WELCOMING THE ECUMENICAL PATRIARCH OF CONSTANTINOPLE, HIS ALL HOLINESS BARTHOLOMEW
sentences: His push for peace includes calling out both the Russian state and the Russian church for the invasion of Ukraine.

In Ecumenical Patriarch Bartholomew's opinion, he says, ``This is the theology that the sister Church of Russia began to teach, trying to justify an unjust, unholy, unprovoked, diabolical war against a sovereign and independent country--Ukraine.'' The Ecumenical Patriarch is a figure who has addressed the European Parliament and the U.S. Congress (in 1997 when he received the Congressional Gold Medal), and has met Heads of State in Great Britain, Canada, South America, Greece, Russia, Norway, Finland, Serbia, Romania, Bulgaria, Albania, Ethiopia, Korea, and Cuba.

He has also traveled to Libya, Syria, Egypt, Iran, Jordan, Azerbaijan, Qatar, and Bahrain, and met with both political and religious figures in those Islamic countries, many of whom no other Christian hierarch of such stature has ever visited.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STREAMLINING PROCUREMENT FOR EFFECTIVE EXECUTION AND DELIVERY AND NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026
statements.title: STREAMLINING PROCUREMENT FOR EFFECTIVE EXECUTION AND DELIVERY AND NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026
sentences: They see the treachery of Russia's invasion of Ukraine and know very well they could be next.
The Baltic people know the harsh reality of living under the Russian thumb and know they could be next if Ukraine falls.
Russia invaded Ukraine because it wants what they call Little Russia to be their vassal state.
A Ukrainian victory is in our national security interests.
A thriving Ukraine that is a democracy with free markets is in our national security interests.
If Ukraine falls, then you can assume that Moldova, Georgia, and others will also fall.
It is not conservative to appease Putin, nor is it conservative to have a lack of moral clarity of who is at fault in this war.
Mr. Chairman, I stand with two-thirds of America, and I oppose this amendment.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STREAMLINING PROCUREMENT FOR EFFECTIVE EXECUTION AND DELIVERY AND NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026
statements.title: STREAMLINING PROCUREMENT FOR EFFECTIVE EXECUTION AND DELIVERY AND NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026
sentences: The 2026 NDAA emphasizes ensuring the lethality of the U.S. Armed Forces by reforming the acquisition process to deliver innovative equipment to the warfighter at speed and scale.
This bill authorizes $142.6 billion for research, development, testing, and evaluation to field essential technologies, like hypersonics, AI, and autonomous vehicles, to win the wars of tomorrow.
Madam Chair, I rise today in strong support of H.R. 3838, our National Defense Authorization Act for fiscal year 2026.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: COMMUNITIES HELPING INVEST THROUGH PROPERTY AND IMPROVEMENTS NEEDED FOR VETERANS ACT OF 2025
statements.title: COMMUNITIES HELPING INVEST THROUGH PROPERTY AND IMPROVEMENTS NEEDED FOR VETERANS ACT OF 2025
sentences: I rise today in support of H.R. 217, Communities Helping Invest through Property and Improvements Needed for Veterans Act of 2025, or the CHIP IN for Veterans Act, a bipartisan bill that strengthens and expands a proven program to deliver modern healthcare facilities for our Nation's veterans more efficiently and at a lower cost to taxpayers.
Mr. Speaker, I urge support for the CHIP IN for Veterans Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: COMMEMORATING MAY 2, 2025 AS NATIONAL SPACE DAY
statements.title: COMMEMORATING MAY 2, 2025 AS NATIONAL SPACE DAY
sentences: Our Nation has long led the way in space exploration.

From the Apollo missions that landed the first humans on the Moon to today's Artemis program, which will take us back to the Moon and beyond, the United States has shown what's possible when bold ideas meet determination.
Space exploration doesn't just inspire; it delivers real benefits to our daily lives.
Nebraska's contributions to space exploration are significant and growing.
Four Nebraska suppliers have contributed to NASA's Artemis program, including manufacturing supplies for Exploration Ground Systems at NASA's Kennedy Space Center.
I encourage all Americans to reflect on how space exploration shapes our lives and futures.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: COMMEMORATING APRIL 29 AS #ENDJEWHATRED DAY
statements.title: COMMEMORATING APRIL 29 AS #ENDJEWHATRED DAY
sentences: From my father's daily devotions, I learned early on that those who bless Israel will be blessed.
This wisdom was reinforced during my first visit to Jerusalem as a fifteen-year-old and later through my service as a Colonel helping establish missile defenses in Israel.
Together, we reaffirm our commitment to unite across party lines and ensure that the horrors of the past remain firmly in the past and that hatred finds no sanctuary in our American society.
Today, as we commemorate #EndJewHatred Day, I stand with Nebraska's Second District and our entire Jewish community in their resilient fight against discrimination and bigotry.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ILLICIT NICOTINE POUCHES FROM CHINA
statements.title: ILLICIT NICOTINE POUCHES FROM CHINA
sentences: While enforcement action has largely focused on e-cigarettes, the Food and Drug Administration has paid little attention to illicit Chinese nicotine pouches and enforcing the rules--especially when the foreign manufacturer failed to apply for FDA authorization.
